description: This file defines a Java Servlet Filter called ContextFilter, which configures and manages context-related objects for OFBiz web applications during request processing. It initializes context parameters, manages multi-tenant logic, sets request attributes, and ensures proper delegation and security setup.

classes.name: ContextFilter
classes.description: A Java Servlet Filter that sets up context objects for OFBiz web applications, including tenant management and security initialization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, loads configuration parameters, and sets up necessary context.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each request, setting various context attributes, managing multi-tenant routing, and continuing the filter chain.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the filter is destroyed.

methods.name: putAllInitParametersInAttributes
methods.description: Copies all servlet context init parameters into request attributes for easier access.

methods.name: getServerId
methods.description: Retrieves or sets a unique server ID for the application context.
